goal: Implement all 32 roadmap features with verified acceptance and original-site releases

features.title: One portable project, including its media
features.scope: Milestone A: one combined portable package containing the plan, its listing media, chosen floor-plan references and an asset manifest. Milestone B: optional online media snapshots with visible quotas, progress, retry and recovery. Local personalization requires A only.
acceptance: Restore a project on another browser profile with every selected media/reference asset, or a precise missing-asset list; never silently present a complete backup.
Failed/partial uploads do not overwrite a complete snapshot; asset ownership and deletion work. Published-link revocation belongs to the separate publication-permissions workflow.
features.boundary: Online media is an explicit opt-in and depends on configured storage. R2 remains deferred; choose storage only after quota/cost evaluation. Private media is excluded from public sharing unless chosen.
evidence: Milestone A extends portable project packages with versioned references and all referenced personal-photo originals, including saved alternatives.
Hash verification precedes import; missing assets are explicit; private metadata excluded from ordinary public sharing.
Milestone B online-media snapshots remains pending; no new private-media hosting or local GPU configuration activated.

features.title: Try A / B / C layouts
features.scope: Named alternatives inside a project; duplicate current design, compare the same camera/room, show what changed, and choose one explicitly.
acceptance: Changing B never changes A; switching preserves each option's dimensions, finishes, floor references and furniture.
Compare uses the same view; restore and choose actions are undoable, and older saves still open.
features.boundary: Start with independent snapshots and compact previews. Do not keep several complete 3D scenes rendering or silently synchronize edits across alternatives.
evidence: Independent alternatives preserve groups, budgets and immutable floor-reference IDs; paired SVG views use one physical scale and view box.
Layout comparison and two-item change highlighting checked in the browser; snapshot restore/undo and reference-only backup restore covered by regression tests.

features.title: Move a set; save a room kit
features.scope: Multi-select, explicit group/ungroup, lock, move/rotate/duplicate as one action, and save a named reusable arrangement.
acceptance: A grouped shelf arrangement keeps supported items at valid relative positions, and ungrouping restores independent selection.
Place a saved kit as a reversible draft; confirmation is one undo step; unavailable items have a clear replacement path.
features.boundary: Group only explicit selections. Include linked support objects only when chosen; retain independently editable contents and authored dimensions.
evidence: Explicit multi-selection, group/ungroup, locks, rigid move/turn/duplicate/delete, per-floor clone compatibility and one-step history.
Recipes and private kits preview before commit; missing models can be explicitly replaced or skipped; replacement resets incompatible source overrides.
Browser drag moved chair/table with exact 720 mm / 100 mm relative offset and one undo; locked actions and stale native-agent edits tested.

features.title: My furniture and belongings
features.scope: Create a private item from a named furniture type, exact width/depth/height, photo, notes and keep/replace status. Save it to a personal collection.
acceptance: Custom dimensions survive placement, duplication, export/import and online saves; the original catalog piece is unchanged.
An approximate item is visibly distinguished from an exact manufacturer model, including in exported schedules.
features.boundary: Start with clearly marked approximate geometry using existing models. Validated GLB import is a later increment, with file/texture/mesh budgets and rights metadata; no automatic model scraping.
evidence: Private measured furniture collection, approximate catalog proxies, keep/replace state, photo originals, explicit preview/confirm and local quota handling.
Private metadata and referenced photos survive portable backups; proxy identity is shown in CSV/print schedules; public/agent views omit private photo IDs and notes.
Browser creation, reload, placement, discard and undo checked.

features.title: Will it actually fit?
features.scope: An optional practical review overlay: inspect furniture gaps, door and drawer opening envelopes, user-set passage widths, and seat pull-out areas; link each warning to the objects involved.
acceptance: Warnings explain which measured space triggered them and respect user-adjusted thresholds and irregular room boundaries.
Turning the overlay off changes no geometry; warnings update only for affected objects and do not make dragging sluggish.
features.boundary: Extend existing measurement/placement safeguards. Begin with simple reliable envelopes. Accessible-space profiles are planning preferences, not certification; fitting through a moving route needs a separate later solver.
evidence: Optional cached footprint/height review covers irregular floors, gaps, supported chair pull-out and explicit approximate door/drawer envelopes.
One bounded non-pickable line mesh persists after closing settings; capture excludes guides; off does not edit saved geometry.
Focused geometry/cache/lifecycle tests and browser gap measurement/selection checked.

features.title: Moodboard linked to the room
features.scope: Pin personal reference images, catalog pieces, finishes and notes; build a palette; preview applying selected colors to a room or group before confirmation.
acceptance: A palette preview can be discarded without changes; applying records one undo step and never recolors locked pieces.
Boards reopen with their source links, accessible labels and selected catalog references.
features.boundary: Keep reference images private by default. Apply to explicit material roles, preserve items the user locks, and retain image attribution. No automatic retailer scraper.
evidence: Private moodboards link named palettes to room/group material roles; linked changes preview and commit once.
Private image/photo references retained in snapshots and portable backups; public plans remove boards and private sources.

features.title: Room recipes and quick starts
features.scope: Offer small editable starting arrangements: reading nook, first apartment, cozy office, hobby corner and guest room. Preview a kit against the user's room and allow choosing what to keep.
acceptance: A recipe works as editable independent furniture after placement and never replaces the user's room without an explicit action.
Templates list required footprint and gracefully show when they cannot fit.
features.boundary: Use original assets and existing placement tools; offer recipes from the library or empty-state affordance rather than another permanent toolbar. Preserve the current one-click Quick layout preference.
evidence: Six editable recipes include footprint reporting, piece choices, support warnings, polygon floor-fit review and explicit confirmation.
Browser preview/apply checked; independent placements, floor holes, diagonal boundaries and undo covered by tests.

features.title: Your art, fabric and memories
features.scope: Upload personal images into frames/canvases and a limited material swatch tool; choose crop, repeat scale and frame color; retain the original file privately.
acceptance: Image crop and physical repeat size survive save/load/export; duplicated items reuse the same asset.
Missing/private images have readable placeholders and never block opening the rest of a shared project.
features.boundary: Do not automatically publish uploads or bake huge images into every placed item. Reuse assets and cap texture size; sharing requires explicit inclusion.
evidence: Private art and fabric uploads with crop, rotation, frame color and repeat dimensions; cloned materials retain originals.
Bounded 16 unique GPU images / two preview decodes, current-floor and selection priority; original photo backup retained. Picture-frame planar mapping verified after save/reload.

Browser upload, wall placement, reload and upright full-image UVs verified; private clones leave original catalog geometry/UVs unchanged. Sixteen 512-pixel textures and two concurrent decodes bound memory.

features.title: Set the mood of your home
features.scope: Saved scene presets such as morning light, rainy afternoon and evening reading; adjustable lamp warmth, modest exterior weather and opt-in sound.
acceptance: Presets retain furniture colors and geometry and restore consistently with saved views.
On the agreed mobile and integrated-GPU scenes, the feature meets measured frame-time and memory budgets; reduced motion removes continuous effects.
features.boundary: Reuse existing lighting/audio/animation. Bound active lights and effects; include static/reduced-motion and silent settings, and stop effects in hidden tabs. This is atmosphere, not weather physics.
evidence: Morning/rain/evening presets, per-lamp overrides, private saved moods and opt-in session sound; preview/apply/discard and one-step undo verified.

Existing four-light pool, 96 bounded rain drops, hidden-tab suspension and reduced motion; geographic studies are a separate opt-in mode. Desktop browser checked; representative mobile/GPU pilot remains unverified.

features.title: Private client review and approval
features.scope: Publish an explicit review snapshot, pin comments to rooms/items/views, request changes or approval, resolve threads, and show which version was reviewed.
acceptance: A reviewer cannot edit the owner's plan or access other projects; revoked review access stops working.
Comments and approval stay attached to the reviewed revision and are visibly stale after a new revision is published.
features.boundary: Start with asynchronous review. Guest identity, access expiry/revocation and owner controls are required; approval is a design decision record, not a contract signature.

features.title: Selections, shopping and room budgets
features.scope: Attach a product URL, vendor, exact/approximate match, manual price/currency and checked date to an item; quantities and room totals; owned/wishlist/selected/ordered status; export a schedule.
acceptance: Totals handle quantities and discounts predictably, never treat unknown prices as zero, and do not combine currencies without explicit conversion.
A schedule identifies exact model vs visual substitute, source URL and price date; alternatives remain separate.
features.boundary: Use user-entered prices first, with explicit unknown values. No invented live prices, stock, shipping or tax; purchasing stays on the vendor site.
evidence: Manual product specifications, owned/buy statuses, quantities/discounts, independent currency totals, explicit unknown prices and floor/room budgets.
CSV and print-to-PDF schedules identify proxy versus product, revision, source and price date.
Browser USD 125.50 selection and USD 1,000 target retained two missing prices; ownership/privacy/escaping/math tests pass.

features.title: Paint, flooring and finish quantities
features.scope: Room-by-room wall/floor/ceiling surface areas, opening deductions, user-set waste and coverage, finish schedule and CSV/PDF export.
acceptance: Sample irregular rooms, openings and multi-floor plans match independently calculated areas within defined numeric tolerance.
Changing a finish, coverage or waste rate updates quantities without resizing geometry; unknown heights remain flagged.
features.boundary: Expose the calculation and units. Define which surfaces count; separate geometric area from purchasable packs. Exclude structural, electrical and plumbing costing.
evidence: Floor/wall/optional projected ceiling quantities use polygon unions and explicit coverage/waste/coats. Unknown inputs remain unavailable.
Measured 6 x 5 metre browser fixture produced 30 square metres floor and 53.636 square metres walls.
Browser-generated CSV matches a 6 m x 5 m room: 30 m2 floor, 53.6359 m2 wall faces. Unknown coverage and ceiling assumptions remain explicit.

features.title: A tour that tells a story
features.scope: Add photo markers and facing arrows to each floor; link a room/marker to existing media. Then use saved views for named tour stops, captions/narration and a read-only embedded viewer.
acceptance: Every stop restores the intended floor/view; hotspots remain readable on small screens and never expose editor controls.
Published tour snapshots are deliberate, revocable and do not silently change as the private project is edited.
features.boundary: Extend Listing Studio and its media provenance. Clearly label an authored/staged design versus a captured property; provide still-image fallback and keyboard navigation.

features.title: Reusable presentation packs
features.scope: Saved brand templates, selected views, option comparison pages, moodboards, selections and revision summaries assembled into a concise client presentation.
acceptance: An unbranded export omits dedicated personal branding fields and warns to review free text and image content.
Every page identifies the included design revision, and selected totals/options match the source snapshot.
features.boundary: Build on existing branded/unbranded exports. Keep styling separate from facts; generate a fresh snapshot of selected content with a preview before export.

features.title: Site notes and verified measurements
features.scope: Attach notes/photos to rooms, walls and objects; record measurement source, check date/reviewer and unresolved questions. Show area breakdown with included/excluded/outdoor categories and explicit calculation basis.
acceptance: Room areas reconcile with the chosen boundary basis; balconies/garages never silently become interior living area.
A corrected wall marks dependent quantities and exports as changed, while its earlier verified value remains traceable.
features.boundary: Keep private survey notes separate from public listing media. User-defined classifications are not a certification of legal living area or measurement standards.

features.title: Existing, remove, proposed
features.scope: Separate existing/proposed states with keep/remove/new markings for architecture and furniture, a change summary and clear before/after comparison.
acceptance: Switching phases does not delete the baseline; exports consistently show phase and revision.
Removing a proposed wall preserves its original counterpart and related doors/windows in the existing state.
features.boundary: Begin as planning layers and versioned alternatives. No load-bearing detection, demolition authorization or permit-ready claims.

features.title: Build your own sectional or shelving
features.scope: An original modular builder for one family first: snap compatible modules, choose orientation/materials, show total dimensions, and place the assembly as editable pieces.
acceptance: Only compatible module joints snap; gaps, mirrored ends and material seams are visually reviewed.
Save/reload, ungroup and undo preserve module identities and total dimensions.
features.boundary: Use Blender-authored modules with attachment metadata; do not imply arbitrary dimensions are manufacturable or copy brand systems. Expand only after one family works.

features.title: Watch your design come together
features.scope: Opt-in build replay from design milestones, with pause/scrub, a chosen camera, and a short exported timelapse or image sequence.
acceptance: A replay reconstructs the selected design milestones accurately after reload without mutating the current project.
Recording can be disabled/cleared, exports are cancellable, and unsupported encoders offer an image-sequence fallback.
features.boundary: Record compact authored events/checkpoints, not the user's screen or input. Do not assume the current undo stack is durable recording; exclude private dialogs and deleted material.

features.title: Little moments of life
features.scope: Turn a lamp on, open a supported door, unfold a sofa bed, run an authored fireplace animation, or place a calm animated pet that rests in selected spots.
acceptance: Interaction never changes the item's saved placement or collision footprint unexpectedly; each state has an accessible control.
Reduced motion provides still poses; idle off-screen items stop updating.
features.boundary: Start with a handful of approved authored states; no full life simulation, rigid-body clutter or wandering across unverified paths. Separate transient play state from saved design.

features.title: Small, optional design challenges
features.scope: Curated challenges such as a reading nook under a size limit, a home for two hobbies, a monochrome studio or a pet-friendly corner; save results privately.
acceptance: A challenge opens a new editable project, never overwrites current work, and all required assets are available.
Optional hints can be dismissed and progress remains local unless explicitly shared.
features.boundary: No timers, pay-to-win items, forced daily streaks or public voting in the first version. Offer constraint completion without judging artistic taste.

features.title: Share a room someone can remix
features.scope: Share an explicit room/kit snapshot with allow-copy permission, attribution, a read-only preview, and 'Make my own' that creates a separate private copy.
acceptance: Remixing never edits the source; copied assets resolve correctly and unauthorized private assets are excluded.
The owner can disable future access; already-downloaded copies are clearly outside revocation.
features.boundary: Extend current sharing; strip listing addresses, private photos and account data by default. Content rights and creator permission travel with the shared kit.

features.title: Follow the sunlight
features.scope: Set north, approximate location/time zone and date/time; scrub a geometric sun/shadow preview; save comparison views.
acceptance: Known north/time examples produce independently checked sun directions, with DST/time-zone handling tested.
Keep the scene responsive while scrubbing and provide a static low-power mode.
features.boundary: Make missing location/orientation visible. This is a visual approximation, not measured lux, energy analysis, plant suitability or certified daylight compliance.
evidence: Date/time, explicit UTC offset, private approximate location and north orientation drive the existing sun/shadow lighting; reference direction and DST-offset cases tested.
Public sharing removes location/date/study names while preserving resolved light direction. Manual sunrise/night states and saved-view atmosphere compatibility retained.

features.title: Wall elevations and clean handoff
features.scope: Generate selected wall elevations with dimensions, opening heights, furniture outlines and notes; export scaled PDF/SVG with a scale check and revision label.
acceptance: Printed scale checks are correct; interior/outer walls, windows and mounted furniture align with the source model.
Exports state units, revision and dimension source and flag approximations or missing measurements.
features.boundary: Start with readable planning drawings. Investigate DXF/IFC only with a concrete receiving workflow and round-trip tests; do not promise BIM or construction documents.
evidence: Orthographic wall elevations and dimensions derived from current model with explicit floor/wall choices and print/export controls.
Browser exports verified as SVG and printable HTML: 6000 mm wall, 2438 mm height, wall artwork base 1200 mm. 1:50 drawing declares 20 mm per metre; physical printer acceptance is not claimed.

features.title: A predictable final-render workflow
features.scope: Preset still-render jobs from saved cameras, preview versus final quality, queue/progress/cancel, original-versus-output comparison, and a portable job package for the already-planned local rendering connection.
acceptance: Output is associated with the exact plan/camera revision and cannot silently replace property evidence.
Failure/cancel/retry states are predictable; a small evaluation set checks geometry, furnishings, runtime and output quality.
features.boundary: The existing local connector is for video, so define and validate a separate still-render job capability before reusing its connection patterns. Prefer fixed-geometry output; generative styling stays labeled and reviewable. Do not install a GPU cluster or introduce a paid provider automatically.

features.title: A design assistant with clear constraints
features.scope: A brief with household needs, favorite styles, locked items, exact dimensions and optional budget; generate a few editable proposals with a plain explanation of tradeoffs.
acceptance: Proposals preserve protected geometry/items, show unmet constraints and require an explicit apply.
Each applied proposal is one undo step; costs/provider use and unavailable functionality are clear.
features.boundary: Reuse native proposal/apply/discard controls. An in-app model service is a separate explicit dependency; unsupported browsers retain manual recipes. No unsolicited paid generation.

features.title: From design to photo day
features.scope: A room/item-based checklist with optional responsible-person label, due date, packing list, delivery status and photos. Start with ready-for-install and ready-for-photos templates.
acceptance: Packing counts reflect the selected design revision and selected versus owned items.
Completing a checklist task does not approve a design or mutate the room; stale lists show changed items.
features.boundary: Export/print the checklist; no auto-email, purchasing, accounting or full project scheduling service. Unknown status stays unknown.

features.title: A garden through the seasons
features.scope: Seasonal material/visibility presets and planting palettes for a selected garden region; summer/winter views using the existing vegetation system.
acceptance: Season changes preserve planting positions/species/IDs and switch back exactly.
Dense-scene budgets remain intact; unsupported species have a neutral fallback rather than a wrong botanical state.
features.boundary: Use cosmetic season states and authored variants; avoid real growth/climate promises or regenerating millions of individual saved objects. Coordinate with the separate model queue.

features.title: See one piece in your real room
features.scope: QR handoff from a selected piece to a capability-detected phone AR viewer with fixed scale and a standard 3D fallback.
acceptance: Reference-size models display at checked real scale on supported devices; unsupported devices get a useful fallback.
Only the explicitly shared model is exposed and the handoff does not reveal private project data.
features.boundary: Start with one item or small kit, not the whole home. Validate separate iOS/Android paths; native AR viewers do not preserve every in-browser interaction.

features.title: Measured capture with a review queue
features.scope: Enhance existing image/PDF recognition with source-linked dimensions, uncertainty highlights and a correction checklist; later pilot native room-scan import.
acceptance: Users can verify a known dimension, correct questionable walls/openings and review all changes before applying.
A representative consented dataset reports geometry/dimension error and time-to-correct, not just successful API responses.
features.boundary: Recognition already exists. Benchmark it before selecting a new model. Apple RoomPlan is a native LiDAR workflow, not a browser-only feature, and manual correction remains available.

features.title: Design together in real time
features.scope: Only after review demand is proven: named collaborators, presence, explicit editing rights, conflict-safe operations and recoverable history.
acceptance: Two concurrent edits and an offline reconnect never silently lose geometry or another person's work.
Viewer/editor access boundaries and recovery history are verified under concurrent changes.
features.boundary: Prototype with two editors first. Do not bolt simultaneous writes onto snapshot saves; define offline conflicts, ownership and deletion/revocation behavior.

features.title: A curated inspiration gallery
features.scope: A small opt-in, moderated gallery of complete rooms and kits with clear creator credit, tags, copy permission and reporting.
acceptance: Only explicitly submitted snapshots become public; removal/reporting and asset-rights handling work.
A gallery room loads within the agreed performance budget and can be copied without losing its source attribution.
features.boundary: Start curated rather than an algorithmic social feed. Exclude private addresses/media and unlicensed assets; moderation, abuse controls and asset storage are real operating costs.

features.title: A staging inventory that knows what is free
features.scope: Only after a staging-business pilot: real stock records, quantity or individual unit IDs, condition, property/date reservations and pack/return lists linked to visual proxies.
acceptance: Concurrent overlapping reservations cannot consume the same physical unit twice.
Replacing a visual proxy does not change ownership, stock quantity or reservation history.
features.boundary: This is a separate professional product surface. Start without barcode hardware or bookkeeping; require server-side concurrency and roles before real reservations.
